title: Celestial Weaver by the River
description: A woman with long dark hair and a flowing blue robe kneels on a starry blue blanket at the edge of a glowing river. She holds luminous threads and constellations that swirl into the water, while ethereal blue birds fly above her under a twilight sky.
prompt: A mystical woman with long flowing dark hair kneels on a starry blue blanket at the edge of a swirling glowing river at dusk. She wears a deep blue robe and holds luminous threads connecting glowing constellations and symbols that flow into the water. Ethereal blue birds made of light fly above her, the sky is filled with dramatic twilight clouds, glowing flowers grow nearby, magical and surreal atmosphere, intricate details, cinematic lighting
